fibonacci_rule.construction: draw Fibonacci from the end of the first downward impulse to the beginning of the first downward impulse
fibonacci_rule.important_note: Both impulse 1 and impulse 2 are downward. The first impulse is the decline after the pump.

notes: Pattern is defined by two downward impulses separated by consolidation/protrading.
Do not interpret the first impulse as bullish.
Potential future confluence: falling wedge, L-shape, local compression, pivot/reversal confirmation.
